howto.goal: Score the most points across every match in the field.
howto.setup: A whole field of seats play each other once. Each match is one choice made together.

sections.title: The choice
sections.text: Choose Work together or Sell them out. Working together pays both 3 points; selling out pays 5 to the seller and 0 to the other.

sections.title: Talking
sections.text: You can talk before choosing. Promises are not enforced — that is the game.

sections.title: The field
sections.text: Every seat plays every other seat once. Points add up across all matches.

controls: Click Work together or Sell them out to choose.
Type a line in the chat to talk before choosing.
Your score is the total across every match.

frames.say: The two choices and what they pay.
Every seat in the field plays every other seat once.
Both choose at once. Together pays 3 each; selling out pays 5 to one and 0 to the other.
Points carry over to the next match.

demo.outro: A promise is only worth what the other seat believes — and they remember last time.

steps.say: Talk before choosing: it costs nothing and may change the answer.
Click Work together or Sell them out to choose.
Remember the same seat plays you again in the field.
Your total across every match is the score that counts.
